field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: Empty because this task invokes no LLM.
field_principles.audit_errors: A complete audit has no hidden failed owned check.
field_principles.causal_control_rows: Template deletion, full reset and shuffled feedback isolate distinct mechanisms.
field_principles.certificate_published: A cold audit does not publish a correctness certificate.
field_principles.checkpoint_receipt: Cold workers consume stable task-owned bytes outside the result.
field_principles.cold_reload_rows: Real subprocess decisions establish persistence rather than dictionary equality.
field_principles.comparison_recomputation_rows: Independent stream intervals protect every fixed producer comparison.
field_principles.default_pipeline_modified: An audit cannot silently enable its measured mechanism.
field_principles.duration_s: Measure monotonic work time; do not pad it to pass a floor.
field_principles.execution_host: Put the actual hostname here, never inside execution_venue.
field_principles.execution_venue: Use exactly host, kv260, gatemate or polarfire; this task uses host.
field_principles.experiment_id: A fixed ID prevents another task from supplying this evidence.
field_principles.field_principles: Echo the reason for each field beside its actual evidence.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Every blocked verdict names failed check, upstream, field, expected and observed value.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Use complete findings or blocked external absence; readiness is not scientific value.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Describe executed computation, not the intended workload.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: The actual operation determines its duration floor.
field_principles.memory_promotion_score: Promotion requires producer value and independent cold causal checks.
field_principles.metric_recomputation_rows: Independent event-level calculations protect the learning headline.
field_principles.milestone: The milestone binds the audit to the V635 contract.
field_principles.model_invoked: False; upstream inference is only cited.
field_principles.no_model_weight_mutation: This audit changes no model weights.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Record the actual resource, code and gate observations.
field_principles.producer_gate_receipt: Producer completion and scientific value remain separate downstream facts.
field_principles.random_seed: Freeze stochastic choices before held-out outcomes are read.
field_principles.refinement_audit_complete_score: A causal audit can finish even when useful learning is absent.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Hash the inputs, code, settings and raw rows.
field_principles.rollback_rows: Rejected poison and stale versions must leave the prior snapshot intact.
field_principles.rows: Keep unit_id, arm, seed, metric, error and abstention for each comparison.
field_principles.run_date: Use 20260911; do not substitute an upstream experiment date.
field_principles.runtime_isolation_receipt: Process, network and model observations limit the audit claim.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: Retain planned, attempted, completed, censored and independent-unit counts.
field_principles.schema: A versioned schema makes incompatible readers fail closed.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Bind source code, input data and frozen contracts to the claim.
field_principles.source_grounding_rows: Public parsing and two exact executors must agree before scoring.
field_principles.status: Write a terminal artifact only after completion or a diagnosed external block.
field_principles.verdict_class: Use exactly positive, circular_positive, null, blocked, disqualified, or partial.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Same correctness authority remains circular even with a separate implementation.

honest_verdict: complete_null: the independent audit completed and producer refinement value was null
inference_substrate: CPU exact public-input parsing, committed-predicate replay, independent event reduction, paired stream bootstrap, and transactional rejection probes; no LLM invocation
